info.title: Skillmark Backend API
info.description: OpenAPI specification generated from the uploaded Spring Boot backend source snapshot.

post.description: Starts an attempt for a published quiz. Requires ACTIVE PARTICIPANT membership and available attempt quota.

get.description: Lists attempts for a quiz. Requires owner permission for the quiz organization.

post.description: Submits answers for the current user's attempt. The backend validates answers, calculates score/pass status, and may issue an automatic certificate.

get.description: Returns attempts owned by the current authenticated user.
Returns an attempt for the attempt owner or the owner of the quiz organization.

post.description: Manually issues a certificate for a submitted passing attempt. Requires owner permission.
Manually issues a certificate for a submitted passing attempt on a MANUAL certificate quiz. Requires owner permission.

get.description: Returns certificates issued to the current authenticated user.
Returns certificates issued under an owned organization.
Returns certificate details for the certificate owner or owner of the issuing organization.

post.description: Revokes an active certificate while preserving it for historical and public verification.

get.description: Publicly verifies a certificate by verification code without requiring authentication. Does not expose sensitive user or attempt data.

post.description: Joins a program using a concurrency-safe invitation usage check; usedCount cannot exceed maxUses.
Adds an existing user as a PARTICIPANT. Requires OWNER membership in the organization.

get.description: Lists organization memberships. Requires OWNER membership in the organization.

delete.description: Marks a participant membership as REMOVED while preserving historical attempts and certificates.

post.description: Creates an organization and automatically creates an ACTIVE OWNER membership for the current user.

get.description: Returns organizations where the current user has an ACTIVE membership.
Returns organization details for an owner or active member.

put.description: Updates organization details. Requires OWNER membership in the organization.

delete.description: Soft deletes an organization. Requires OWNER membership in the organization.

get.description: Returns audit logs for an owned organization.

patch.description: Updates program status. Status is the source of truth; isPublished is derived from status == PUBLISHED.

post.description: Creates a draft quiz in an owned program.

get.description: Owners see all non-deleted quizzes; participants see only published quizzes if enrolled.
Owners see organization quizzes; participants see published quizzes in organizations where they are active members.
Returns quiz details for the organization owner or active member when the quiz is published.

put.description: Updates quiz settings. After attempts exist, only title and description can change.

delete.description: Archives a quiz using a soft deletion policy. Requires owner permission.

post.description: Adds a SINGLE_CHOICE question with options. Exactly one option must be correct.

put.description: Updates a question and its options until the quiz has submitted attempts. Requires owner permission.

delete.description: Deletes a question until the quiz has submitted attempts. Submitted attempt history is protected from destructive changes.

post.description: Adds an option until the quiz has submitted attempts. Requires owner permission.

put.description: Updates an option until the quiz has submitted attempts. Requires owner permission.

delete.description: Deletes an option until the quiz has submitted attempts. Submitted attempt history is protected from destructive changes.

post.description: Publishes a quiz after validating that it has valid questions, options, settings, and exactly one correct option per SINGLE_CHOICE question.

patch.description: Updates quiz status. Status is the source of truth; isPublished is derived from status == PUBLISHED.
Shows or hides a quiz for participants. Owner access only.

get.description: Returns the current authenticated user's safe profile without password or token hashes.

patch.description: Updates the current user's local profile fields.

post.description: Compatibility alias for updating the local user profile.

isPublished.$ref: #/components/schemas/= "Compatibility field derived from status == PUBLISHED. Do not treat as an independent state.") boolean
